trades.thesis: FDA extended the povetacicept PDUFA by up to 3 months after a late-cycle information request (major amendment), and VRTX fell ~7.5% (a ~$10B market-cap loss) from a 52w-high close of 564 to ~523. Peak sales are $3.4-4B, so a 3-month delay plus a modest rise in CRL risk is worth far less than $10B; JPM (OW 570), Citi (Buy 585) and TD Cowen (575) all reiterated. The move also erases the whole 3-day run-up, so part of it is profit-taking.
